evals.name: bulk-powerbi-folder-horizon-and-clustering
evals.prompt: Migrate all 15 Power BI .pbit files in ./exports/finance_bi into Snowflake Semantic Views, Cortex Agents, and dashboards.
evals.expected_output: Detects surface, runs Step 0 (encourages Horizon Catalog BI connector as optional faster path, scans existing Semantic Views and Cortex Agents), runs scripts/preflight_batch.py to cluster reports by shared base tables into Subject Areas, checks overlap with existing assets, and stops at ONE Batch Approval Gate before building.
expectations: Detects Desktop/CLI vs Snowsight surface before staging or dispatching workers
Encourages Horizon Catalog metadata connector without blocking the file path
Scans existing Semantic Views and Cortex Agents before creating new ones
Clusters reports by shared Snowflake base tables rather than creating 15 duplicate Semantic Views
Stops at one Batch Approval Gate confirming Subject Areas, consolidation choices, target DB/schema, and batch page consent

evals.name: existing-sv-and-agent-consolidation
evals.prompt: We already have ANALYTICS.FINANCE.FINANCE_CORE_SV and FINANCE_AGENT. Bring in 6 new Finance Power BI and Tableau dashboards without duplicating our semantic layer.
evals.expected_output: Preflight computes base-table overlap against FINANCE_CORE_SV and FINANCE_AGENT, recommends consolidate or reuse, asks the user explicitly whether to consolidate/extend, reuse as-is, or create new, and wires all migrated dashboards FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(...).
expectations: Matches incoming Subject Area tables against existing Semantic Views and Agents
Explicitly asks user to choose consolidate, reuse, or create_new
Inspects existing view before extending rather than blindly overwriting it
Wires every migrated dashboard to the consolidated/reused Semantic View

evals.name: single-dashboard-guided-compatibility
evals.prompt: Run semantic layer discovery with a customer starting from one Executive Sales Tableau workbook (exec_sales.twbx) and a screenshot.
evals.expected_output: Routes to Single-Dashboard Mode (01-intake Path 1B), inspects XML locally before staging, checks existing Semantic Views, builds one Semantic View via agent-studio, creates one Cortex Agent, validates against the screenshot, and offers Step 5 front-end options.
expectations: Triggers cleanly on legacy semantic-layer-discovery phrasing
Follows Single-Dashboard Path 1B without forcing bulk estate setup
Validates against the provided screenshot baseline
Requires explicit user choice before building Streamlit, App Runtime, or Dashboard front end

evals.name: snowsight-sequential-fallback
evals.prompt: In Snowsight Workspaces (/workspace exists), migrate 8 Tableau workbooks in /workspace/bi_exports into dashboards and semantic views.
evals.expected_output: Detects surface=snowsight inline, stages via COPY FILES FROM snow://workspace (never cortex ws cp), and runs batch_state.py next-batch --limit 1 sequentially.
expectations: Uses COPY FILES instead of PUT or cortex ws cp
Uses sequential --limit 1 waves in Snowsight
Isolates scratch directories under /tmp/bulk_bi/<slug>/

evals.name: partial-blocker-needs-input-and-resume
evals.prompt: Migrate a folder of 5 Tableau workbooks where 1 workbook references a missing published datasource stub (sqlproxy).
evals.expected_output: Preflight flags B004 on the 1 blocked workbook and marks it needs_input with whats_missing and what_i_need while completing the other 4 workbooks, then resumes only the paused item without re-running completed work.
expectations: Healthy workbooks complete without being blocked by 1 missing .tds
Blocked workbook records exact whats_missing and what_i_need in batch_manifest.json
Resume skips all completed Semantic Views, Agents, and dashboards

evals.name: hard-negative-unrelated-sql-tuning
evals.prompt: Optimize this slow Snowflake warehouse query that joins three staging tables and spills to remote storage.
evals.expected_output: Does not trigger agentic-bi-migration (unrelated query performance tuning with no BI dashboards or semantic layer request).
expectations: Does not load agentic-bi-migration or run preflight_batch.py
